where n.is_deleted = 'N'
and upper(n.title) like '%' || upper(#{kw}) || '%' escape '\'
and upper(n.content) like '%' || upper(#{kw}) || '%' escape '\'

mapper.update: update notice set view_count = view_count + 1 where notice_seq = #{noticeSeq} and is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select: select n.notice_seq, n.admin_seq, n.updated_by, n.title, n.content, n.is_pinned, n.view_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at, m.nickname as writer_name from notice n left join member m on n.admin_seq = m.member_seq where n.notice_seq = #{noticeSeq} and n.is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.insert:
select seq_notice.nextval from dual
insert into notice ( notice_seq, admin_seq, updated_by, title, content, is_pinned, view_count, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{noticeSeq}, #{adminSeq}, null, #{title}, #{content}, #{isPinned}, 0, 'N', systimestamp, systimestamp )
mapper.update: update notice set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = systimestamp where notice_seq = #{noticeSeq} and is_deleted = 'N'
update notice set is_deleted = 'Y', updated_by = #{adminSeq}, deleted_at = systimestamp, updated_at = systimestamp where notice_seq = #{noticeSeq} and is_deleted = 'N'
